name: CoA display patch stream: bot sessions receive no patch rows
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1 and the leveling legendary catalog.
A client session that never sends the extension handshake receives the patch stream from the 5 s fallback.
A bot session has no client, so neither the login stream nor an obtained item's row is sent to it.
SMSG_PATCH_LOADING_SCREENS (0x05F8) opens every stream; SMSG_PATCH_ITEM (0x0932) carries the item row.
Socketless packet construction does not establish live client timing or rendering.

steps.label: The client session receives the fallback login stream once
The bot session receives no login stream
The client session receives the obtained item's row
The bot session receives no item rows
